notes: Density: residents per km2 of the hex's land on each date (GUS). Change: population on the date / population on 2015-12-31 - 1.
From 2021-12-31 GUS counts are based on the 2021 census, earlier ones on the 2011 census: part of the change between 2020 and 2021 comes from that rebasing.
Each year is on that year's gmina borders.
